text: That energy drink in your hand? Heart researchers just flagged it.
Not for the sugar. For your heart.
They dug through nine years of FDA safety reports. Twenty-eight thousand of them.
Reports on energy drinks and stimulant supplements mentioned heart attacks over four times more often.
But cardiac arrest? Eleven times. That's when your heart just... stops.
And almost half those heart reports came from people eighteen to thirty-four.
Now, reports aren't proof. Nobody knows yet if the drink caused it.
But some cans pack three hundred milligrams of caffeine. The daily limit for most adults is four hundred.
So researchers want bigger studies. And there's still no U.S. age limit to buy them.
So before you crack open the next one... take a look.
